facts.fact: The NCSA's Data Protection and Privacy Office says controllers and processors register with the National Cyber Security Authority under Law No. 058/2021 on the protection of personal data and privacy.

The NCSA's Data Protection and Privacy Office says controllers and processors register with the National Cyber Security Authority under Law No. 058/2021 on the protection of personal data and privacy.
The NCSA's Data Protection and Privacy Office published guidance on what registered controllers and processors must do after registering under Law No. 058/2021.
